Career Area: 
Engineering 
 Job Description: 
 
 Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 
 
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
 
 The Autonomy Development Engineer II develops and delivers production-quality software that enables autonomous and semi-autonomous functionality for heavy equipment in mining and construction environments.
 
 This role operates with moderate independence, owning features or subsystems while contributing to system-level design decisions. The engineer applies strong software engineering practices to solve real-world problems and supports development across the full lifecycle, from concept through validation and release. The role collaborates closely with cross-functional teams and begins to influence technical direction while supporting the advancement of autonomy technologies into production environments.
 
 Our CAT Technology Automation and Autonomy teams are focused on evolving the state of the art and bringing emerging automation & autonomy technology into the harsh production environments found on typical mining and construction jobsites. As we continue to enhance and develop new products we will be hiring across;
 Command (Hauling, Dozing, Surface Loading, Drilling)
 Core Autonomy Development Framework
 Platform Engineering (Planning, Positioning, Perception)
 Safety Solutions (Operator Augmentation, Collision Mitigation, AI Assistant)
 Remote Control Solutions
 Site Technology (Surface, Underground, and Construction)
 Modeling & Simulation (AI, Digital Twins, Simulation)
 What You Will Do: 
 Develop production-quality C/C++ software for autonomy and automation systems
 Own feature or subsystem development across the full software lifecycle (design, implementation, validation, release)
 Contribute to requirements definition, architecture discussions, and technical trade-offs
 Troubleshoot and resolve moderately complex software and system issues
 Support verification, validation, and functional safety activities
 Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and validation teams
 Communicate technical approaches, risks, and status to stakeholders
 Provide peer support and informal mentorship to junior engineers
 
 What You Have: 
 Programming:  Strong proficiency in C/C++
 Ability to interpret system designs and implement scalable solutions
 Solid debugging, profiling, and performance optimization skills
 
 Software Development Life Cycle:  Experience contributing to all phases of development lifecycle
 Ability to independently execute development plans and adapt to changes
 
 Problem Solving:  Solves complex but well-defined technical problems
 Evaluates trade-offs and recommends solutions
 Uses structured methodologies and data-driven analysis
 
 Technical Troubleshooting:  Discovers, analyzes, and resolves software or application problems. 
 Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting. 
 Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used. 
 
 Education Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field – or commensurate industry experience.
 
 Consideration for Top Candidates: 
 Autonomy Feature Development Experience developing autonomy domains such as planning, positioning, perception, or controls 
 Robotics frameworks (e.g., ROS )
 Translating prototypes or research into production autonomy software
 Experience with autonomous or semi‑autonomous machine behavior
 
 Autonomy Platform & Framework Development Experience building autonomy frameworks, middleware, or shared libraries 
 Linux‑based development environments
 CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern DevOps practices
 Hardware/software integration at the platform level
 Enabling multiple teams through reusable software foundations
 
 Embedded, Remote Control & Real‑Time Systems Embedded C/C++ development in real‑time systems 
 AUTOSAR Classic Platform (BSW, RTE)
 Remote control or operator‑assist system development
 CAN, Ethernet, and vehicle/machine networks
 Model‑based development using Matlab/Simulink 
 
 Experience in Construction or Mining Industries preferred
 
 Additional Information: 
 This position is to work onsite at our Mossville, IL office.
 Some teams may also work out of our Irving, TX.
 Relocation assistance may be available for this position.
 Visa sponsorship is NOT available for this position
 This position may require travel up to 15%
 #LI
  
  
 
 Summary Pay Range: 
 
$97,530.00 - $158,480.00 
 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar. 
 
 
 Benefits: 
 Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.
 Medical, dental, and vision benefits*

 Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)*

 401(k) savings plans*

 Health Savings Account (HSA)*

 Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)*

 Health Lifestyle Programs*

 Employee Assistance Program*

 Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts*

 Career Development*

 Incentive bonus*

 Disability benefits

 Life Insurance

 Parental leave

 Adoption benefits

 Tuition Reimbursement

         
 * These benefits also apply to part-time employees
 
  
  
 
This position requires working onsite five days a week.  
  
Relocation is available for this position.  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.  
  
 
 Posting Dates: 
September 9, 2026 - November 1, 2026 
 Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.
 
 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.  Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.
 
 Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community .
